Overview

We are seeking a Senior Data Governance amp Architecture Specialist to join our Corporate Data Office to strengthen Corporate-wide data governance capabilities and enable trusted well-architected high-quality data The Corporate Data Office is responsible for establishing and executing world-class Corporate-wide data governance to ensure all data assets are proactively and efficiently governed and managed across Saudi Aramco to foster a data driven organization and promote data value realization in line with its strategic goals as well to adequately comply with national and international data regulations Your primary role will be to translate governance policies and standards into practical operating processes data architecture deliverables measurable data quality controls and effective use of corporate data governance platforms This role partners with business data owners data stewards technology teams and other stakeholders to improve accountability discoverability consistency and reliability of critical data assets
Key Responsibilities
Data Governance
• Implement and continuously improve corporate data governance policies standards procedures and stewardship practices
• Define and maintain data ownership stewardship responsibilities critical data elements business glossaries and governance workflows
• Support governance forums issue escalation compliance assessments adoption metrics and remediation tracking
Data Architecture
• Develop and maintain conceptual and logical data models data definitions domain mappings and architecture standards in collaboration with solution architects
• Document data flows system-of-record relationships data integration patterns and end-to-end lineage for priority data domains
• Review solution designs for alignment with data standards interoperability reuse and governance requirements
Data Quality
• Establish data quality dimensions business rules profiling methods thresholds and monitoring controls for critical data
• Coordinate data quality assessments root-cause analysis remediation plans and issue management with business and technical owners
• Define scorecards KPIs and reporting to measure and communicate improvements in data quality
Data Governance Platform
• Support selection configuration deployment integration and ongoing enhancement of corporate data governance platforms
• Configure and administer metadata catalogs business glossaries lineage stewardship workflows data quality capabilities and role-based access as applicable
• Drive platform onboarding metadata ingestion user acceptance testing training adoption and operational support in partnership with IT and vendors

You must have a Bachelor Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, Engineering, or a related discipline. You should have a minimum of 10 years relevant experience across data governance, data architecture, data quality, metadata management, or corporate data platforms, including hands-on delivery responsibilities. You should have a demonstration experience implementing governance frameworks, stewardship models, business glossaries, metadata catalogs, and data quality processes. Practical knowledge of data modeling, data integration, metadata, lineage, SQL, and data quality profiling and monitoring is also essential. You should have hands-on experience with at least one corporate data governance or catalog platform (e.g., Collibra, Informatica, Microsoft Purview, or equivalent). Working knowledge of DAMA-DMBOK principles and applicable data privacy, security, and regulatory requirements is required. You must also be able to demonstrate strong stakeholder engagement, analytical problem-solving, communication, and cross-functional delivery skills.

Job description:
Job Purpose

To design and govern the enterprise data architecture, ensuring data is structured, integrated, secure, and high-quality to support business operations, analytics, and regulatory compliance.
Key Accountability Areas

Data Architecture Design:
• Design and maintain the enterprise data architecture across the organization.
• Develop conceptual, logical, and physical data models to support business and technical requirements.
• Define data standards, architecture principles, and integration patterns.

Data Integration & Management:
• Design and oversee data integration solutions across multiple systems and platforms.
• Define ETL/ELT processes and ensure reliable data flow between source and target systems.
• Address data redundancy, inconsistency, and fragmentation issues.

Data Quality & Governance:
• Establish and enforce data quality standards and controls.
• Contribute to data governance frameworks, policies, and procedures.
• Ensure proper metadata management and data lineage tracking.

Security & Compliance Support:
• Collaborate with cybersecurity and privacy teams to ensure secure data architecture.
• Support compliance with data protection regulations such as PDPL and GDPR where applicable.
• Implement data classification and access control standards.

Technology & Infrastructure:
• Evaluate and recommend data architecture tools, technologies, and platforms.
• Support database design (relational and non-relational systems).
• Optimize data systems for performance, scalability, and reliability.
Role Accountability

HR Proficiency:
• Ability to obtain updated soft and technical skills related to the job.

Delivery:
• Perform the planned activities to meet the operational and development targets as per delivery schedules.
• Utilize resources effectively to achieve objectives within efficient cost and time.
• Provide a periodic report formatted by detailing the deviation and execution of planned tasks.

Problem-Solving:
• Solve any related problems arise and escalate any complex operational issues.

Quality:
• Ensure quality requirements to develop effective quality control and processes including specifications for products or processes or related activities.

Business Process Improvements:
• Coordinate well-defined written systems, policies, procedures, and seek automations opportunities as much as possible.

Compliance:
• Comply to related policy and procedures and work instructions.

Health, Safety and Environment:
• Ensure compliance of relevant safety, quality, and environmental management procedures and controls within defined area of work activity to guarantee safety, legislative compliance, and delivery of high-quality products/services.
